title: Independent Office of Evaluation (IOE) - Mandate & Methodology Explainer
shortDescription: 2D/2.5D motion graphics explainer produced from scratch - storyboard, vector illustration, rigging, and sound mix - to clarify the mandate and evaluation methodology of IFAD’s Independent Office of Evaluation.
mandateChallenge: Transform dense institutional evaluation protocols into an approachable 3-minute animated story for member states, rural development partners, and civil society.
executionCraft: Illustrated custom vector assets in Illustrator, built orbital camera rigs in After Effects, and engineered the full soundscape and voiceover mix in Audition.
impactMetric: Flagship Institutional Onboarding Asset · Global Distribution
